name: Lindsey Wilson College
oos_note: Private single rate = in-state. Lindsey Wilson College is a private, independent liberal arts college (United Methodist affiliated) charging one tuition rate to all students regardless of residency. Tuition & fees 2026-27 = $28,976/yr (tuition $14,328 + activity fee $94 + technology fee $66 per semester, doubled) per lindsey.edu cost-and-financial-aid page.
